summary: iter236 — FixPlan main98 N98-6 / EA 1.60 ACCOUNT_TRADE_MODE end-to-end verification. ALL in-scope checks GREEN. Backend unit lane: `cd /app/backend && DB_NAME=ai_trading_bot_test python -m pytest tests/unit -q -p no:warnings` → 938 passed in 14.73s (includes tests/unit/test_fixplan_main98_n6.py's 6 tests, as expected). Integration lane: `pytest tests/integration/test_r29_audit.py tests/integration/test_r27_account_environment_attestation.py tests/test_demo_readiness.py tests/test_fixplan_main93_a9.py -q` → 37 passed in 3.78s. Live HTTP vs REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL (preview): GET /api/health → ea_version='1.60', build_sha=4a99ea85. Heartbeat scratch flow (seed TEST_ account in DB ai_trading_bot with user_id/VTMarkets-Demo server, bridge_tokens.token_fields): HB{trade_mode:'demo'}→200 and sets account_trade_mode='demo' + account_trade_mode_reported_at; HB without trade_mode (ea_version 1.57, legacy) → 200 and does NOT clear account_trade_mode; HB{trade_mode:'banana'} → 200 and is ignored (banana never persisted); HB{trade_mode:'real'} → 200, account_trade_mode='real', ops_alerts row kind='demo_attestation_contradicted' severity='warning' dedup_key='demo_attestation_contradicted:<acc_id>', admin_audit_log action='account_environment_contradicted' with entry_hash present; second HB{real} does NOT duplicate (count stays 1, occurrences 1→2); broker_env.broker_environment(acc) == attested_environment(acc) == 'LIVE'. Admin HTTP (admin@trading.bot login via csrf cookie + X-CSRF-Token): GET /api/admin/account-environments → each row carries broker_trade_mode and proof.checks includes BOTH broker_not_real_money AND broker_reports_demo (ids: terminal_identity_authoritative, server_reported_matches_declared, login_reported_matches_account, heartbeat_fresh, no_live_capital_indicator, server_demo_named, broker_not_real_money, broker_reports_demo). GET /api/admin/demo-readiness (note hyphen — the review-request wrote 'demo/readiness' but the real route is 'demo-readiness') → 200, checks[] contains id='fleet_broker_demo', fleet_ea title = 'Every demo account runs the current EA (1.57–1.59 accepted on attested DEMO accounts)', fleet rows carry broker_trade_mode. POST /api/admin/account-environments/{id} with {environment:'DEMO', password:<admin pwd>} on a scratch account whose broker reported real → 409 {code:'declared_not_demo', message:'…attestation cannot downgrade it'} (expected). Frontend (admin UI /admin/brokers): data-testid='account-environments-panel' renders; new BROKER column shows 4 cells with data-testid 'account-env-broker-mode-<id>' all displaying '— (EA < 1.60)' (expected for the preview's legacy EA accounts); onboarding Step 2 reads 'Install the STOIC EA (v1.60+)'. Scratch Mongo rows cleaned up after each run. Admin login succeeded without MFA (admin_mfa_enabled=false in preview).
action_items: Minor doc nit (not a bug): review request calls out '/api/admin/demo/readiness' but the actual route is '/api/admin/demo-readiness'. No code change needed — just flag in release notes to avoid confusion for the next tester.
critical_code_review_comments: _trade_mode_contradiction in bridge_routes.py correctly distinguishes severity (critical when a formal environment_attestation existed, warning when the account was only declared demo) and only fires when broker_env.broker_environment(prior) or attested_environment(prior) == 'DEMO', so legacy EAs (<1.60) with no trade_mode cannot trigger a false contradiction.

bridge heartbeat ignores unknown TRADE_MODES values (observed 'banana' → 200 and no persistence), and absence of trade_mode in payload (legacy EA 1.57) is a true no-op on the account_trade_mode field — exactly the regression-safety the task required.

Admin attest route runs reauth BEFORE the DEMO contradiction check — this is correct for the audit chain (actor identity verified) but means callers hitting /admin/account-environments/{id} without `password` get 401 reauth_failed instead of 409 declared_not_demo. Behaviour is intentional; mention in /app/scripts for next tester.

success_rate.backend: 100% (938/938 unit, 37/37 integration, 19/19 live HTTP heartbeat/alert/audit, 9/9 admin HTTP, 1/1 attest 409)
success_rate.frontend: 100% (panel + broker-mode cells + BROKER column + EA 1.60 copy)

test_credentials: admin@trading.bot — password read from /app/memory/test_credentials.md at runtime, injected via TEST_ADMIN_PASSWORD env var; never written to any file under /app.
seed_data_creation: Scratch accounts (label 'TEST_N98_6_*') with VTMarkets-Demo server+broker_server in DB ai_trading_bot collection 'accounts' were created and deleted per test run. Associated ops_alerts (dedup_key demo_attestation_contradicted:<id>) and admin_audit_log entries (action account_environment_contradicted, target_id <id>) were cleaned up in the test teardown. No residual TEST_ rows remain.
context_for_next_testing_agent: To exercise N98-6 live: load /app/backend/.env (BRIDGE_TOKEN_HASH_KEY required), use bridge_tokens.token_fields(token) to seed a scratch account with REQUIRED fields {label, account_type:'demo', server+broker_server (demo-named), login, user_id, created_at, **tf}. Missing user_id causes ws_manager.broadcast(acc['user_id']) to KeyError and return 500 — not a product bug, just a seed-data requirement. The real demo-readiness route is '/api/admin/demo-readiness' (hyphen), NOT '/api/admin/demo/readiness'. Attest endpoint requires {password:…} in JSON body for the reauth step before the 409 check will run.
rca of the issue: No product bugs observed. The one 500 encountered during setup was a test-seed oversight (missing user_id on scratch account) which blocked the ws_manager.broadcast call AFTER all N98-6 DB side-effects already executed correctly — i.e. the heartbeat logic is sound; only the WS fan-out needs a user_id. Not a regression; documented for future testers.
